column1: # MODE: DEV
# MODE-MANIFEST.tsv -- lists this skill's own files whose install package
# tier (DEV ships only in a --package dev build; PROD ships in both, since
# dev is the inclusive superset) cannot be declared with the usual embedded
# `# MODE: DEV` / `<!-- MODE: DEV -->` marker, because the format has no
# comment syntax to carry one.
# Read ONLY by src/installer/src/install.rs's own collect_relative_files, as
# an override consulted before a file's own header -- NOT read by
# install.sh/skill_files() or installer/build-release.sh, which already solve
# this same "no comment syntax" problem their own way (build-release.sh's
# listed_by_installer() takes such files straight from skill_files() itself).
# This manifest is deliberately scoped to the Rust installer only; its
# entries describe the same real files skill_files()'s planning dev arm
# lists, not a shared source with it.
# TODO: once this pattern is proven out, promote MODE-MANIFEST.tsv from an
# exceptions-only override to the DEFAULT classification mechanism for every
# file (not just the ones a marker cannot carry), and retire the in-file
# marker convention for install-tier purposes. Not done yet: markers remain
# load-bearing for installer/build-release.sh's declares_prod() and for
# tests/test-mode-markers.sh's own cross-check, so that is a separate,
# larger migration touching the bash build tooling, not a Rust-only change.
# path
.gitignore
PACKAGE-MAP.tsv
skill-source.txt
